files.README.md:
# exposed-ddl-mariadb

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities and table objects for Exposed 1.6.1, repositories and services, in Kotlin on the JVM. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mariadb.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return the entities; updates take a Patch per field: absent, or a value that may be null.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/main/kotlin/app/AppDatabase.kt      the connection of DATABASE_URL
src/main/kotlin/app/UnitOfWork.kt       the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/main/kotlin/app/errors/             NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/main/kotlin/app/entities/           one entity and one table object per table
src/main/kotlin/app/repositories/       the repositories of each table
src/main/kotlin/app/services/           one service per table
src/test/kotlin/app/                    repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json                      what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_URL="jdbc:mariadb://localhost:3306/app" TEST_DATABASE_USER=app TEST_DATABASE_PASSWORD=app gradle test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

package app

import app.repositories.AuditEntryRepository
import app.repositories.EmptyRepository
import app.repositories.KindRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryAuditEntryRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryEmptyRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryKindRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryOrderRepository
import app.repositories.MemoryThingRepository
import app.repositories.OrderRepository
import app.repositories.ThingRepository

/** The in-memory repositories, for tests and for trying the services without a database. */
class MemoryUnitOfWork : UnitOfWork {
    override val things: ThingRepository = MemoryThingRepository()
    override val kinds: KindRepository = MemoryKindRepository()
    override val order: OrderRepository = MemoryOrderRepository()
    override val auditEntries: AuditEntryRepository = MemoryAuditEntryRepository()
    override val empties: EmptyRepository = MemoryEmptyRepository()

    /** Memory has no transactions: changes are kept as they are made. */
    override fun <T> transaction(work: (UnitOfWork) -> T): T = work(this)
}

package app

import app.repositories.AuditEntryRepository
import app.repositories.EmptyRepository
import app.repositories.KindRepository
import app.repositories.OrderRepository
import app.repositories.SqlAuditEntryRepository
import app.repositories.SqlEmptyRepository
import app.repositories.SqlKindRepository
import app.repositories.SqlOrderRepository
import app.repositories.SqlThingRepository
import app.repositories.ThingRepository
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.jdbc.Database
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.jdbc.transactions.transaction as exposedTransaction

/** The repositories over one database, and its transaction. */
class SqlUnitOfWork(val db: Database) : UnitOfWork {
    override val things: ThingRepository = SqlThingRepository(db)
    override val kinds: KindRepository = SqlKindRepository(db)
    override val order: OrderRepository = SqlOrderRepository(db)
    override val auditEntries: AuditEntryRepository = SqlAuditEntryRepository(db)
    override val empties: EmptyRepository = SqlEmptyRepository(db)

    /** Joins the transaction already open, or opens one. */
    override fun <T> transaction(work: (UnitOfWork) -> T): T = exposedTransaction(db) { work(this@SqlUnitOfWork) }
}

package app

import app.repositories.AuditEntryRepository
import app.repositories.EmptyRepository
import app.repositories.KindRepository
import app.repositories.OrderRepository
import app.repositories.ThingRepository

/** What services depend on: a repository per table and a transaction. Each service operation runs in transaction(): committed when it ends, rolled back when it throws. */
interface UnitOfWork {
    val things: ThingRepository
    val kinds: KindRepository
    val order: OrderRepository
    val auditEntries: AuditEntryRepository
    val empties: EmptyRepository

    /** Runs work with the repositories of the transaction; commits when it ends, rolls back when it throws. */
    fun <T> transaction(work: (UnitOfWork) -> T): T
}

package app.entities

import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.core.Table
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.javatime.date

/**
 * The "kinds" table, as the database has it. Exposed never creates or changes it: the database already exists.
 */
object KindTable : Table("kinds") {
    val code = varchar("code", 10)
    val day = date("day")
    val label = varchar("label", 30).nullable()

    override val primaryKey = PrimaryKey(code, day)
}
package app.entities

import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.core.ReferenceOption
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.core.Table
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.core.java.javaUUID
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.javatime.CurrentDateTime
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.javatime.date
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.javatime.datetime
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.javatime.time

/**
 * The "Order" table, as the database has it. Exposed never creates or changes it: the database already exists.
 *
 * CHECK (`group` >= 0): the services check what they understand of it.
 */
object OrderTable : Table("Order") {
    val id = long("Id").autoIncrement()
    val user = varchar("user", 40)
    val group = integer("group").default(0)
    val customerName = varchar("customerName", 60)
    val `class` = text("class").nullable()
    val metadata = text("metadata").nullable()
    val date = date("date").nullable()
    val time = time("time").nullable()
    val text = varchar("text", 20).nullable()
    val list = text("list").nullable()
    val str = varchar("str", 10).nullable()
    val int = integer("int").nullable()
    val dueDate = date("dueDate")
    val closesAt = time("closesAt").nullable()
    val createdAt = datetime("createdAt").defaultExpression(CurrentDateTime).nullable()
    val kindCode = varchar("kind_code", 10).nullable()
    val kindDay = date("kind_day").nullable()
    val thingId = javaUUID("thing_id").nullable()
    val parentId = long("parentId").nullable()

    override val primaryKey = PrimaryKey(id)

    init {
        uniqueIndex(null, customerName)
        foreignKey(thingId to ThingTable.id, onDelete = ReferenceOption.SET_NULL)
        foreignKey(parentId to id)
        foreignKey(kindCode to KindTable.code, kindDay to KindTable.day)
    }
}

    val tiny = short("tiny")
    val small = short("small")

    val num = integer("num").nullable()
    val big = long("big")

package app

import app.common.Patch
import app.errors.ConflictException
import app.errors.NotFoundException
import app.errors.ValidationFailedException
import app.services.OrderChanges
import app.services.OrderService
import java.util.UUID
import kotlin.test.BeforeTest
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFailsWith
import kotlin.test.assertNotNull
import kotlin.test.assertNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

/** The service of the "Order" table, on the in-memory repositories. */
class OrderServiceTest {
    private lateinit var uow: MemoryUnitOfWork

    @BeforeTest
    fun open() {
        uow = MemoryUnitOfWork()
    }

    @Test
    fun createsAValidRow() {
        val service = OrderService(uow)
        val parent0 = Factories.addThing(uow, 100)
        val parent1 = Factories.addOrder(uow, 100)
        val parent2 = Factories.addKind(uow, 100)
        val row = Factories.newOrder(1)
        row.thingId = parent0.id
        row.parentId = parent1.id
        row.kindCode = parent2.code
        row.kindDay = parent2.day
        val created = service.createOrder(row)
        val found = service.getOrder(created.id!!)
        assertEquals(created.id, found.id)
    }

    @Test
    fun refusesAMissingValue() {
        val service = OrderService(uow)
        val parent0 = Factories.addThing(uow, 100)
        val parent1 = Factories.addOrder(uow, 100)
        val parent2 = Factories.addKind(uow, 100)
        val row = Factories.newOrder(1)
        row.thingId = parent0.id
        row.parentId = parent1.id
        row.kindCode = parent2.code
        row.kindDay = parent2.day
        row.user = null
        val error = assertFailsWith<ValidationFailedException> { service.createOrder(row) }
        assertEquals(listOf("user"), error.errors.map { it.field })
    }

    @Test
    fun refusesARepeatedUniqueValue() {
        val service = OrderService(uow)
        val parent0 = Factories.addThing(uow, 100)
        val parent1 = Factories.addOrder(uow, 100)
        val parent2 = Factories.addKind(uow, 100)
        val row = Factories.newOrder(1)
        row.thingId = parent0.id
        row.parentId = parent1.id
        row.kindCode = parent2.code
        row.kindDay = parent2.day
        val first = service.createOrder(row)
        val again = Factories.newOrder(2)
        again.thingId = parent0.id
        again.parentId = parent1.id
        again.kindCode = parent2.code
        again.kindDay = parent2.day
        again.customerName = first.customerName
        assertFailsWith<ConflictException> { service.createOrder(again) }
    }

    @Test
    fun keepsItsOwnUniqueValue() {
        val service = OrderService(uow)
        val parent0 = Factories.addThing(uow, 100)
        val parent1 = Factories.addOrder(uow, 100)
        val parent2 = Factories.addKind(uow, 100)
        val row = Factories.newOrder(1)
        row.thingId = parent0.id
        row.parentId = parent1.id
        row.kindCode = parent2.code
        row.kindDay = parent2.day
        val created = service.createOrder(row)
        val updated = service.updateOrder(created.id!!, OrderChanges(customerName = Patch.of(created.customerName!!)))
        assertEquals(created.customerName, updated.customerName)
    }

    @Test
    fun refusesAMissingParent() {
        val service = OrderService(uow)
        val parent0 = Factories.addThing(uow, 100)
        val parent1 = Factories.addOrder(uow, 100)
        val parent2 = Factories.addKind(uow, 100)
        val row = Factories.newOrder(1)
        row.parentId = parent1.id
        row.kindCode = parent2.code
        row.kindDay = parent2.day
        row.thingId = UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000999999")
        val error = assertFailsWith<ValidationFailedException> { service.createOrder(row) }
        assertTrue("thing_id" in error.errors.map { it.field })
    }

    @Test
    fun saysWhenARowIsMissing() {
        val service = OrderService(uow)
        assertFailsWith<NotFoundException> { service.getOrder(999999L) }
    }

    @Test
    fun changesARow() {
        val service = OrderService(uow)
        val parent0 = Factories.addThing(uow, 100)
        val parent1 = Factories.addOrder(uow, 100)
        val parent2 = Factories.addKind(uow, 100)
        val row = Factories.newOrder(1)
        row.thingId = parent0.id
        row.parentId = parent1.id
        row.kindCode = parent2.code
        row.kindDay = parent2.day
        val created = service.createOrder(row)
        val updated = service.updateOrder(created.id!!, OrderChanges(user = Patch.of("changed")))
        assertEquals("changed", updated.user)
    }

    @Test
    fun deletesARow() {
        val service = OrderService(uow)
        val parent0 = Factories.addThing(uow, 100)
        val parent1 = Factories.addOrder(uow, 100)
        val parent2 = Factories.addKind(uow, 100)
        val row = Factories.newOrder(1)
        row.thingId = parent0.id
        row.parentId = parent1.id
        row.kindCode = parent2.code
        row.kindDay = parent2.day
        val created = service.createOrder(row)
        service.deleteOrder(created.id!!)
        assertFailsWith<NotFoundException> { service.getOrder(created.id!!) }
    }
}
